**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear Miss [name deliberately obscured][^2]
I hope I am not tormenting you but on account of other engagements I am anxious to know whether you could come this week or next.

The week that begins with the 7th and has Ash Wednesday in it, I am going to spend at [Mr Wilson](../persons.html#1541)’s but the one after that I shall be at home again if that suited you better than within the next fortnight

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper, endorsed ‘1869’.

[^2]: Possibly [Elizabeth Missing Sewell](../persons.html#1301), a number of whose letters from CMY are marked in this way.
